reason: Fresh audit after #432 authorization merge and #433 Stage RED proves two governance defects block Fast Closure V2 from being real rather than procedural convention: trusted WP0 routing fails closed on root AGENTS.md as WP0_ROUTE_UNKNOWN_PATH, while shared/release/implementationBranchPolicy.js binds failure-first evidence to the fixed second first-parent commit instead of the first production commit. That fixed-ordinal rule would let an additional tests-only diagnostic commit consume the old evidence slot and leave the eventual production commit unenforced. This work package reuses the existing base-owned WP0 routing policy, existing governanceBootstrapPaths exact-add semantic guard and existing delegated implementation policy; it adds no second policy engine, workflow, dependency or infrastructure. The repair must route AGENTS.md as an exact governance path and extend the existing failure-first parser with an opt-in Fast Closure V2 diagnostic-window contract that permits consecutive tests-only causal RED commits and binds exact RED evidence plus unknownBlockers=0 to the first production commit using the latest diagnostic RED head.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact normalized repository-relative paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

Fresh RED proves the existing delegated route mutation guard must authorize exactly AGENTS.md as a governanceBootstrapPaths addition and reject unrelated route-policy drift.
After implementation AGENTS.md is added only to governanceExactPaths; no governance/product prefix is widened and unknownPathFailsClosed remains true.

After implementation a Fast Closure V2 opted-in authorization may have RED1 tests-only, RED2 tests-only carrying RED1 evidence, then a first production commit carrying RED2 evidence plus Yance-Closure-Matrix-Unknown-Blockers: 0.
A Fast Closure V2 diagnostic commit that changes a production path, omits prior RED evidence, references the wrong RED head, or uses a non-failure conclusion is rejected.
A first production commit that lacks the latest RED evidence or unknownBlockers=0 trailer is rejected.
Legacy failureFirstCommit authorizations without Fast Closure V2 opt-in keep their current semantics and remain GREEN.
No workflow, dependency, product renderer, Graphiti runtime, database, sidecar or second policy engine is introduced.
